nl: Rename the field Total of the Go struct store.Order to Sum. Keep the JSON tag "total", format the struct as gofmt does (aligned columns) and update the struct literal in the test.
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('internal/store/store.go'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('\tID       int     `json:"id"`\n\tCustomer string  `json:"customer"`\n\tTotal    float64 `json:"total"`\n') == 1, 'internal/store/store.go'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('\tID       int     `json:"id"`\n\tCustomer string  `json:"customer"`\n\tTotal    float64 `json:"total"`\n', '\tID       int     `json:"id"`\n\tCustomer string  `json:"customer"`\n\tSum      float64 `json:"total"`\n').encode())
p = pathlib.Path('internal/store/store_test.go'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('Total: 12.5') == 1, 'internal/store/store_test.go'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('Total: 12.5', 'Sum: 12.5').encode())
EOF
